description: 軍校盃網路安全競賽 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 國防部參謀本部. 為使國軍資安教育朝學理與實務結合之目標精進，進而培育未來國軍網路作戰優秀專業人才，責由國防大學理工學院整合資源、人力及訓場能量，並邀請我國各軍事院校學生組隊參加，期藉比賽參與交流，形成正向學習刺激，以培育國軍資安技術能力。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 國防部參謀本部. Its tags are 服兵役. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
